sentences.text: Shri Jagdish Baheti, learned counsel for the appellant.
Shri Santosh Singh Thakur, learned Public Prosecutor fo  respondent/State.
Shri Prashant Jain, learned counsel for the complainant.

Heard on I.A No.10965/2024 , which is second application under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C for grant of suspension of jail sentence filed on behalf of appellant Rambharose Prajapati mainly on the ground that the matter has been compromised between the parties.

The appellant has been convicted under Sections 363, 376(3)(N), 376(D-A) of IPC and Section 5(G)
r/w Section 6 of POCSO Act and sentenced to undergo R.I for 7 years, 20 years, life imprisonment,
R.I for 10 years with fine of Rs.2000/-, Rs.3000/-, Rs.3000/-, Rs.2000/- with default stipulation.
Counsel for the appellant submits that the matter has been compromised between the parties and the dispute has been resolved.
By order dated 13/8/2024, the matter was sent for verification of compromise before the Principal Registrar of this Court.

A verification report has been received in which after considering the no objection submitted alongwith the affidavit of complainant and father of the complainant it is stated that the parties have compromised voluntarily without any threat, 2 CRA-8219-2019 inducement or coercion.
Counsel for the State supports the order of conviction and sentence.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and considering the fact that the parties have resolved the dispute without any threat,
inducement or coercion, we are of the opinion that the present application deserves to be allowed.
Accordingly, I.A No.10965/2024 is allowed.

The jail sentence of appellant Rambharose Prajapati is suspended upon his depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited, and on furnishing a bail Rambharose Prajapati vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/9931308/
1 bond of Rs.50,000/-(Rupees fifty thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 21/11/2024 and on subsequent dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Registry.
